blurb:
Step beyond the headlines and into the heart of a modern uprising. This immersive audio journey takes you through George Floyd Square, exploring the profound duality of a space that is simultaneously a site of deep national trauma and a vibrant, community-sustained autonomous zone. Guided by an expert in political movements and a passionate local historian, you will uncover the hidden stories of mutual aid, radical art, and spiritual resilience that transformed a tragic intersection into a global symbol of resistance. This is not just a tour about what was lost, but a profound look at what a community chose to build in the aftermath.

A 0.6 km self-guided tour with 6 stops over 62 min
Ideal for travelers interested in Power, Protest & Civic Spaces and History & Memory
Immersively told in a podcast style by experts and locals
Matching audio content, AI guide and navigation through the app
